calls.head: Vegas’s power play has a target
calls.body: Vancouver’s penalty kill sits 28th of 32, and Vegas’s power play is 3rd (8.7 expected goals per 60).
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas’s power play created 13.0 expected goals per 60 in 7:53 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 8.7, and scored 1 goal.

calls.head: Vegas should get plenty of shots away
calls.body: Vegas ranks 9th of 32 for shot volume (59.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Vancouver ranks 32nd for shot suppression.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 3 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas took 56.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against its usual 59.5.

VAN.head: We gave Vancouver only a 23% chance, and it went the way we feared.

VGK.head: We gave Vegas a 77% chance, and Vegas delivered.

surprises.head: Vegas controlled the chances
surprises.body: Expected goals ran 4.6 to 1.6 for Vegas, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Vancouver shot far less than usual
surprises.body: 33.2 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 45.7.

surprises.head: Vancouver tried a different line
surprises.body: E. Pettersson, L. Karlsson, M. Rossi played 7:09 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Vancouver’s usual lines.
